Acceptable use policy
What you can and can't do with Shopinbos, so the platform stays safe for sellers, buyers, suppliers and riders.
Sell real products you are allowed to sell, and describe them honestly.
No scams, fake reviews, spam or harassment.
No illegal, dangerous or counterfeit goods.
We can remove content or pause an account that breaks these rules.
Who this applies to
This policy applies to everyone who uses Shopinbos: sellers, their staff, suppliers, delivery partners and anyone who visits a store built on Shopinbos. It is part of our Terms of service.
Where the Seller rules, Supplier terms or Delivery partner terms say more about a topic, those more detailed rules apply too.
Everyone who uses Shopinbos agrees to this policy.
Things you must not sell

Anything that is illegal in Nigeria, or in the place you deliver to. This includes controlled drugs, prescription medicines without the right licence, firearms, ammunition and explosives, and wildlife products that are protected.
Counterfeit or fake branded goods, or products that copy someone else’s trademark or design without permission.
Stolen goods, goods you don’t have the right to sell, and recalled or unsafe products.
Adult content, gambling services, and financial products such as loans, investments or crypto schemes that promise returns.
Food, drinks, cosmetics and supplements that need NAFDAC registration but don’t have it.
If it is illegal, fake, stolen or unsafe, it can’t be sold on Shopinbos.
Honest selling
Product photos, descriptions, prices, sizes and delivery times must be true. Don’t hide extra charges until after payment.
Don’t post fake reviews, pay for reviews, or review your own products. Don’t pretend to be another business or person.
Pay on delivery orders must be real orders. Don’t create orders to test riders or collect delivery codes.
Tell buyers the truth about what they are paying for.
Messages and marketing
Only send WhatsApp, SMS or email marketing to people who agreed to hear from you, and stop when they ask you to.
Don’t send spam, chain messages or messages that pretend to come from Shopinbos, a bank or a delivery company.
Treat customers, riders, suppliers and our support team with respect. Threats, hate speech and harassment are not allowed.
Message people who want to hear from you, and be respectful.
Using the platform fairly
Don’t try to break into accounts, test our security without permission, overload our systems, or copy our app or website with bots or scrapers.
Don’t use Shopinbos to collect people’s passwords, card details or bank details outside our checkout.
Don’t resell or share your account, or create new accounts to get around a pause or a ban.
Use Shopinbos as it is meant to be used.
What we do when the rules are broken

We may remove a product or content, hold payouts linked to a problem order while we look into it, pause features, or close an account. We tell you what happened and why, unless the law or a safety concern stops us.
Where we see a crime or a risk to someone’s safety, we may report it to the police or the right authority.
If you think we got it wrong, reply to our message or write to legal@shopinbos.com and a person will review it.
We act in proportion to the problem, and you can ask us to review a decision.
Reporting a problem
To report a store, product or message that breaks this policy, use the Report link on the store, message us on WhatsApp, or email legal@shopinbos.com with the link and what is wrong.
To report a copy of your brand or content, see our Copyright and trademark complaints page.
Tell us, and we will look into it.

Data protection (NDPA)
How Shopinbos meets the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023, and what sellers need to do for their own customers’ data.
We follow the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 (NDPA).
For your account we are the data controller. For your customers’ details, you are, and we process them for you.
We keep data secure, only use it for the reasons we give, and help you answer your customers’ requests.
Our Data Protection Officer is at privacy@shopinbos.com.
Our commitment
Tech Della Solutions Ltd (RC 7038770), which runs Shopinbos, follows the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 and the rules of the Nigeria Data Protection Commission (NDPC).
This page explains how we apply the law across the product. Our Privacy policy explains what we collect about you and why.
We take the NDPA seriously and build Shopinbos around it.
Who is responsible for what
For information about you as a seller, supplier or delivery partner, we are the data controller.

For information about your customers (names, phone numbers, addresses, orders), you are the data controller and we are your data processor. We only use that information to run your store, deliver orders and give you the tools you turn on.
We don’t sell your customers’ data, and we don’t use it to market to them for other sellers.
Your customers are your customers. We process their data for you.
What we do as your processor
We process your customers’ data only on your instructions, which are the settings and features you use in Shopinbos.
Our staff and the companies that help us run Shopinbos (hosting, payments, messaging and delivery) are bound to keep data confidential and secure.
If there is a personal data breach that affects your customers, we tell you without undue delay, with what we know and what we are doing about it, so you can meet your own duties.
When you close your account, we delete or return your customers’ data, except what the law requires us to keep, such as payment records.
We handle your customers’ data carefully and tell you quickly if something goes wrong.
What sellers need to do
Have a lawful reason to collect each customer’s details. For orders and delivery, that is the contract with your customer. For marketing, it is usually their consent.
Only send marketing messages to customers who agreed, and stop when they ask. Shopinbos records opt-ins and opt-outs for you.
Answer your customers’ requests to see, correct or delete their data. You can do this from the customer page in the app, or ask us to help.
Get consent for marketing, and respect your customers’ choices.
Security
Data is encrypted in transit and at rest. Access inside Shopinbos is limited to the people who need it, and we keep logs of access to sensitive data.
Card payments are handled by Paystack, which is PCI DSS certified. We never see or store full card numbers.
We protect data with encryption and strict access.
Data outside Nigeria
Some of our service providers store data outside Nigeria. When that happens, we use the safeguards the NDPA requires, such as contracts that give the same level of protection.
If data leaves Nigeria, it stays protected.
Contact and complaints
Our Data Protection Officer can be reached at privacy@shopinbos.com.
If you are not satisfied with our answer, you can complain to the Nigeria Data Protection Commission.
Write to privacy@shopinbos.com with any data question.
privacy@shopinbos.com

Copyright and trademark complaints
How to tell us that a store on Shopinbos is using your brand, photos or content without permission, and what happens next.
Send us the link, what is yours, and proof that it is yours.
We review every complaint and usually act within 3 working days.
The seller can reply if they believe they have the right to use it.
Repeat infringers lose their store.
What you can report
Use this process if a store built on Shopinbos copies your trademark, logo or brand name, uses your product photos or written content without permission, or sells fake versions of your products.
For other problems, such as scams or unsafe products, see our Acceptable use policy.
Report copies of your brand, photos or content here.
How to send a complaint

Email legal@shopinbos.com with: the link to the store or product; what you own (for example a registered trademark number, or the original photo); a short statement that the use is not allowed by you or the law; and your name, company and contact details.
If you are writing for someone else, such as a law firm or agency, say who you represent.
Please make sure your complaint is accurate. A false complaint can harm an honest small business.
Send the link, proof of ownership and your contact details.
What happens next

We review the complaint, usually within 3 working days. If it is clear, we remove or hide the content and tell the seller, with a copy of your complaint (we can leave out your personal contact details if you ask).
If something is missing, we ask you for it before we act.
We check it, act on clear cases and tell the seller.
If you are the seller
If your content was removed and you believe you have the right to use it, for example you are an authorised reseller or you took the photo yourself, reply with your proof.
We share your reply with the person who complained. If they don’t show us within 10 working days that they have started legal action, we may restore the content.
Sellers can reply with proof that they have the right to use it.
Repeat infringement
We close stores that keep using other people’s brands or content after warnings.
Keep copying, lose your store.

Affiliate programme terms
The rules for earning a commission by referring new sellers to Shopinbos.
Share your link, and earn when the people you refer start paying for Shopinbos.
Be honest in how you promote us. No spam, fake reviews or paid ads on our brand name.
Commissions are paid monthly to your bank once they are confirmed.
We can change or end the programme with notice.
Joining
You can join the affiliate programme from the Shopinbos app or website if you are 18 or over and have a Nigerian bank account in your name or your business’s name.
We may decline or remove an affiliate whose content or audience is not a good fit, for example content that breaks our Acceptable use policy.
Anyone 18+ with a Nigerian bank account can apply.
How you earn
You get a personal link and code. When someone signs up through your link and starts a paid plan, you earn the commission shown in your affiliate dashboard at the time they sign up.

A referral counts when the new seller signs up within 30 days of clicking your link and has not had a Shopinbos account before. If two affiliates refer the same person, the last link they clicked counts.
You earn when a new seller you referred starts paying.
How you are paid
Commissions are confirmed 30 days after the referred seller pays, so refunds and chargebacks can be taken into account.
Confirmed commissions are paid to your bank account once a month, when your balance is at least ₦5,000. You are responsible for any tax due on your earnings.
Confirmed commissions are paid monthly to your bank.
How you can promote Shopinbos
Do: share honest reviews, tutorials and your own experience, and say clearly that you earn a commission.
Don’t: send spam, post fake reviews, offer cash back or rewards we haven’t approved, run paid search ads on the words Shopinbos, Rex or Peggy, or pretend to be Shopinbos.
Don’t sign yourself or your own businesses up through your own link.
Promote honestly and say you are an affiliate.
Ending the programme
You can leave any time. We can remove you if you break these terms, and we won’t pay commissions earned through breaking them.
We may change these terms or end the programme. We give at least 30 days’ notice by email, and pay confirmed commissions earned before the change.
Either side can end it. Earned commissions are still paid.

Security and responsible disclosure
How we protect Shopinbos, and how to tell us about a security problem safely.
Found a security issue? Email security@shopinbos.com.
Give us reasonable time to fix it before sharing it publicly.
Don’t access other people’s data or disrupt the service while testing.
We won’t take legal action against good-faith research that follows these rules.
How we protect Shopinbos
Data is encrypted in transit and at rest. Sign-in uses one-time codes, so there are no passwords to steal. Staff access to sensitive data is limited and logged.
Card payments go through Paystack, which is PCI DSS certified. We never store full card numbers.
We use encryption, passwordless sign-in and strict access.
Reporting a vulnerability
Email security@shopinbos.com with a description of the issue, the steps to reproduce it, and the impact you think it has. Screenshots or a short video help.
We reply within 3 working days and keep you updated while we fix it.
Email security@shopinbos.com with the details.
Rules for testing
Only test with accounts you own. Don’t access, change or delete other people’s data; if you reach it by accident, stop and tell us.
Don’t run denial of service attacks, spam, social engineering of our staff or sellers, or physical attacks.
Give us reasonable time to fix the issue before you share it publicly.
Test with your own accounts, and don’t cause harm.
Our promise
If you follow these rules in good faith, we won’t take legal action against you or ask the police to investigate, and we will credit you if you want us to.
Good-faith researchers are safe with us.
Scams using our name
Shopinbos will never ask for your one-time code, your bank PIN or your password on WhatsApp, by phone or by email. If someone does, it is a scam: report it to us and don’t share the code.
Never share your one-time code with anyone.
security@shopinbos.com
